decision.reasoning_trace: I initially filtered out accessories like cooking gear, water bottles, and patches to focus on actual backpacks. Within the backpack category, I looked for products with high ratings and high review volumes to ensure quality. My consideration set includes a mix of lightweight packable bags, large tactical assault packs, and internal frame hiking packs. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) is the final choice because it offers an exceptional balance of features, including a high 4.7-star rating with over 6,000 reviews, large capacity, and a very competitive price of $39.99. This makes it a more robust and versatile choice than the packable daypacks or the more expensive internal frame models.
